Organizations and governments around the world are working to address this issue. For example, some initiatives provide menstrual products to schools, distribute them through local pharmacies, or even develop affordable, reusable alternatives. These efforts aim to ensure that all women have access to the necessary resources to manage their periods comfortably and hygienically, regardless of where they live.
